dataDefinition.source: locally collected OKX public REST snapshots
dataDefinition.limitation: not a lossless websocket event stream; no live authorization

strategyDefinition.alphaInput: five-snapshot midpoint microbars and public-trade notional volume; not native exchange OHLCV candles
strategyDefinition.model: StandardScaler + Ridge on future mid-price return
strategyDefinition.entry: signal threshold plus online Beta win-rate and expected-value gate
strategyDefinition.exits: volatility-scaled dynamic target/stop or maximum hold
strategyDefinition.execution: executable bid/ask, taker fees and adverse slippage

decision.rule: 验证期望为正，测试每个标的和成本压力均盈利，且最差回撤不超过3%；否则仅研究。
